title: NOC overview
intro: Set up a big-screen view: average node CPU as a single number, over the last hour.

objectives.text: Add a Stat panel of avg(node_cpu_usage) with unit Percent
Set the time range to Last 1 hour

hints: avg() without by () gives a single series.
Stat panel, unit Percent (0-100), time range Last 1 hour.
solution: Stat panel: avg(node_cpu_usage), unit Percent; time range Last 1 hour
debrief: Big-screen dashboards should answer one question per panel, readable from across the room.
